ModMetaData.name: Quiet New Factions - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Nelim's Quiet New Factions, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
One scenario marks a faction as required for its own duration; the marker is removed afterwards, and it lives in memory only, so a restart clears it too.
